This matter is taken up through Hybrid arrangement (video conferencing/physical mode).
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

The petitioner Dhurba Charan Jena has filed this writ petition for recalculation of the land acquisition compensation of the petitioner and for a direction to the opposite parties to pay the revised compensation amount along with interest to the petitioner as per the provisions of the Rights to Fair Compensation & Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Re-Settlement Act, 2013 (hereafter '2013 Act').
Section 64 of the 2013 Act, which deals with Reference to Authority states that if any person interested who has not accepted the award may, by written application to the Collector, require that the matter be referred by the Collector for the determination of the Authority, as the case may be,
whether his objection be to the measurement of the land, the amount of the compensation, the person to whom it is payable and etc. including the apportionment of the compensation among the persons interested.

sentences.text: 1 It is clear that the petitioner has not availed such remedy and he has just filed a representation before the Special Land Acquisition Officer, Anandapur Barrage Project, Keonjhar under Annexure-3.
Learned counsel for the petitioner seeks permission of this Court to withdraw this writ petition in order to enable the petitioner to avail the remedy as enshrined under section 64 of the 2013 Act.
Accordingly, the writ petition stands disposed of as withdrawn.
Urgent certified copy of this order be granted on proper application.

( S.K. Sahoo)
 Judge Digitally Signed ( Chittaranjan Dash)
